Inspect Wheel event transitions

Advance supported Wheel triggers from explicit state, or compose them with complete-property Active hits to see which later damage changes.

This lab currently covers Doomsday Rampage after card use, Light of Intellect after a Keeper skill, and Eternal Weave plus Rota Fortunae after a pursuit. Examples use the supported resource-150 baseline; Doomsday ownerAttack must be the live AtkForce value for that build. It does not infer a loadout, create triggering cards, emit events automatically, or fill unknown state. The damage composition requires complete supplied property maps.

Interpretation
